name: Nicepage
description_en:
Nicepage is a visual builder for HTML websites and designs used with WordPress or Joomla. It offers a desktop application, Online Builder, WordPress plugin and Joomla extension, with different project, export and hosted-service limits by plan. Nicepage hosting is for generated HTML sites, not a general-purpose server for arbitrary applications.

The crucial purchase decision is both the edition and the license model. An annual subscription keeps premium access active for its term; a lifetime license preserves eligible desktop/plugin versions but includes only one year of updates and online services. Keep editable project backups and review version compatibility before upgrading.
description_zh:
Nicepage 是用于 HTML 网站及 WordPress、Joomla 设计的可视化构建器，提供桌面应用、Online Builder、WordPress 插件和 Joomla 扩展；各方案的项目、导出和托管服务限额不同。Nicepage 托管面向生成的 HTML 网站，不是运行任意应用的通用服务器。

购买的关键同时包括版本档和许可模式：年度订阅在期限内保留高级访问，终身许可保留符合条件的桌面/插件版本，但更新和在线服务仅含一年。升级前应保留可编辑项目备份并核对版本兼容性。

core_features.name_zh: HTML 与 CMS 设计流程
core_features.explanation_en: Desktop/Online can export WordPress and Joomla themes; the CMS plugins edit supported content but do not export Nicepage projects.
core_features.explanation_zh: 桌面/在线构建器可导出 WordPress 和 Joomla 主题，CMS 插件编辑受支持内容，但不能导出 Nicepage 项目。

core_features.name_zh: 区分终身许可与订阅规则
core_features.explanation_en: Lifetime access applies to eligible desktop/plugin versions; online services and latest Online Builder access remain time-limited.
core_features.explanation_zh: 终身权利适用于符合条件的桌面/插件版本，在线服务及最新版 Online Builder 访问仍有期限。

core_features.name_zh: 可编辑项目备份与导入
core_features.explanation_en: Online projects can be backed up and imported into Desktop as local unpublished projects; generated HTML is not an importable editor project.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在线项目可备份并导入桌面，成为本地未发布项目，生成的 HTML 不能作为编辑器项目导入。

pricing.summary_en: Starter free with finite project/service quotas; rendered Personal/Business/Pro subscription annual monthly equivalents $6.75/$12.75/$18.75. Lifetime-license pricing is separate, with only one year online services/updates; checkout currency/tax unconfirmed.
pricing.summary_zh: Starter 免费但项目/服务额度有限；渲染页 Personal/Business/Pro 年订阅月均 $6.75/$12.75/$18.75。终身许可单独定价，仅含一年在线服务/更新，结账币种/税费未确认。

sections.title_en: Choose the output and editing location
sections.title_zh: 选择输出格式及编辑位置
sections.en: For an HTML site, create in Desktop or Online Builder, inspect responsive layouts, then publish to Nicepage or export for external hosting according to the plan. For WordPress/Joomla work, design and export the theme from Desktop/Online; the pricing FAQ says themes cannot be edited directly inside those CMSs and their Nicepage plugins cannot export a project. Keep the source project in the original builder. Nicepage does not import arbitrary HTML/generated sites and says it has no API. Confirm these boundaries before planning automated builds or a round-trip migration.
sections.zh: HTML 网站可在桌面或 Online Builder 创建，检查响应式布局后，按方案发布到 Nicepage 或导出供外部托管。WordPress/Joomla 工作应从桌面/在线构建器设计并导出主题；定价 FAQ 称不能直接在 CMS 内编辑主题，Nicepage CMS 插件也不能导出项目。应在原构建器保留源码项目。Nicepage 不能导入任意 HTML/生成站点，并称不提供 API；规划自动构建或往返迁移前必须确认这些边界。

sections.title_en: Read capacity per project, hosted site and service
sections.title_zh: 分别读取项目、托管站点与服务容量
sections.en: The rendered subscription page displays Starter $0, Personal $6.75/month, Business $12.75 and Pro $18.75, with paid amounts billed annually. The screenshot confirms superscript cents; the text extractor incorrectly joins them into 675/1275/1875, which are not the prices. Currency code and checkout total remain unconfirmed. Desktop project counts are 2/5/50/unlimited; online projects are 2/5/10/20. Personal/Business/Pro include 1/3/5 connected-domain HTML hosted sites, distinct from project counts. Their per-site storage is 1/3/5 GB and monthly visit allowances 25,000/100,000/500,000. Starter lists 250 MB, 1,000 monthly visits, 50 lifetime form submissions and 20 lifetime calendar appointments. Paid service quotas are per month per site, not lifetime; e.g. Personal forms 250 and appointments 50.
sections.zh: 渲染订阅页显示 Starter $0、Personal 月均 $6.75、Business $12.75、Pro $18.75，付费金额按年结算。截图确认上标是分币；文本提取错误连接成 675/1275/1875，不能将其当作价格。货币代码和结账总额尚未确认。桌面项目数为 2/5/50/不限，在线项目数为 2/5/10/20。Personal/Business/Pro 含 1/3/5 个连接域名的 HTML 托管站点，与项目数不同；每站存储为 1/3/5 GB，月访问量为 25,000/100,000/500,000。Starter 列出 250 MB、月访问 1,000、终身 50 次表单提交和 20 次日历预约。付费服务为每站每月配额，例如 Personal 表单 250、预约 50，不能与终身额度混淆。

sections.title_en: A lifetime version is not lifetime online service
sections.title_zh: 终身版本不等于终身在线服务
sections.en: The June 2026 explanation says a lifetime license keeps the Desktop, WordPress plugin and Joomla plugin versions released within the active update period. It includes one year of updates, website hosting and online services; Online Builder always runs the latest version and is not permanently licensed by that purchase. An expired subscription instead sends all editors to Starter and stops premium tools/services. The pricing FAQ further says online services revert to Starter, the custom domain disconnects and published sites remain active for 12 months after expiry. Resolve the intended hosting and renewal route before relying on continued branded access. Switching a lifetime model to subscription is described as ending the original lifetime model, so verify the chosen switch before paying.
sections.zh: 2026 年 6 月说明称，终身许可保留更新期内发布的桌面、WordPress 插件和 Joomla 插件版本，包含一年更新、网站托管和在线服务；Online Builder 始终使用最新版，不因该购买获得永久许可。订阅到期则所有编辑器转为 Starter，高级工具/服务停止。定价 FAQ 进一步说在线服务转为 Starter、自定义域名断开，已发布站点在到期后继续有效 12 个月。依赖持续品牌域名访问前，应明确托管和续费路径。说明还称终身模式转为订阅会结束原终身模式，付款前应核对所选切换。

sections.title_en: Verify domain, form email and source backup
sections.title_zh: 验证域名、表单邮件与项目备份
sections.en: Publish opens Publish and Export with Nicepage Hosting as default; inspect the destination rather than assuming an external host. The dialog checks custom-domain assignment and can request verification of the email used for form submissions. After publishing, the dashboard records status/time and offers unpublish. For recovery, download an online-project backup or import it into Desktop, where the imported copy is local and unpublished. Export backups before updating: newer versions can change project structure so the old licensed version may no longer open it. A lifetime user can stay on a covered version, but that is not a substitute for a restorable backup and a compatible CMS environment.
sections.zh: 点击 Publish 打开 Publish and Export，默认目的地为 Nicepage Hosting，应核对目的地，不能假定是外部主机。对话框检查自定义域名，并可能要求验证接收表单提交的邮件。发布后面板记录状态/时间并提供取消发布。恢复时可下载在线项目备份或导入桌面，导入副本是本地未发布状态。更新前应导出备份，新版本可能改变项目结构，导致旧许可版本无法打开。终身用户可停留在覆盖版本，但不能由此替代可恢复备份和兼容 CMS 环境。

sections.title_en: Separate hosting, CMS and usage rights
sections.title_zh: 区分托管、CMS 与使用权
sections.en: Nicepage’s FAQ allows external hosting and describes its own hosting as generated HTML hosting, excluding general PHP/JS/other-file hosting. Its CMS/eCommerce scope is WordPress/WooCommerce and Joomla/VirtueMart, not arbitrary application stacks. Offline desktop use requires prior online sign-in and loses template/media libraries while offline. The EULA grants limited usage rights and restricts redistribution; client content-editing licenses are not separate desktop seats, and the license explanation permits two devices without simultaneous use. No open-source license for the builder was established. This can fit a visual designer willing to manage version/project artifacts; teams needing unrestricted code import, API automation or a fully portable dynamic application should resolve those needs first. No installation, form, payment, backup restore or deployment was tested.
sections.zh: Nicepage FAQ 允许外部托管，将自身服务描述为生成 HTML 网站的托管，排除通用 PHP/JS/其他文件托管。CMS/电商范围是 WordPress/WooCommerce 与 Joomla/VirtueMart，不能推广到任意应用栈。桌面离线使用需要先在线登录，离线无法使用模板/媒体库。EULA 授予有限使用权并限制再分发；客户内容编辑许可不是独立桌面席位，许可说明允许两设备但不能同时使用。本次未确立建站器开源许可。愿意管理版本和项目文件的视觉设计师可考虑它；需要任意代码导入、API 自动化或完整可迁移动态应用的团队应先解决这些需求。本次未实测安装、表单、支付、备份恢复或部署。
